provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 97% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the Mame breaks 'propagandam' across a page turn and its recogniser pulls the running head 'M. P. A. L. (B. Joannis Leonardi Conf.)' into the gap, so the layer reads 'pro- / M P A L B Joannis Leonardi Conf / pagandam'; the word itself is present and unbroken on the page, which I read at 300 dpi (artifact PDF pp. 1086-1087); the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 105921-105933 (66% coverage); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 95615 (87%; comparison only, never a publication basis). Recorded limitation: The antecedent reading is taken from that witness's text layer, not from a page image, so its letterforms are inferred rather than read; only the 1962 target was read on a page. I did not collate the antecedent's Introit, readings, chants or any Secunda Oratio / Alia Secreta / Alia Postcommunio.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Joannem Confessorem tuum ad fidem in gentibus propagandam
mirabiliter excitare dignatus es, ac per eum in erudiendis fidelibus novam
in Ecclesia tua familiam congregasti: da nobis famulis tuis, ita ejus
institutis proficere; ut praemia consequamur aeterna. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Suscipe, Domine, oblationem mundam salutaris hostiae: et praesta; ut,
intercedente beato Joanne Confessore tuo, ubique gentium jugiter offeratur.
Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Pretiosi Corporis et Sanguinis tui sacris refecti mysteriis, Domine,
adprecamur: ut, beati Joannis Confessoris tui exemplo, studeamus confiteri
quod credidit, et opere exercere quod docuit: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo
Patre in unitate.
